newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen official off to Saudi to discuss border.
newsitem.headline: Yemen official off to Saudi to discuss border.

text.p: Yemen's Interior Minister Hussein Mohammad Arab left for Saudi Arabia on Tuesday carrying a message from President Ali Abdullah Saleh to King Fahd on border issues, Sanaa radio reported.
"The trip comes within the framework of exchange of visits between the two countries to discuss the question of borders in a manner satisfying both parties," it quoted Arab as saying.
The interior minister said he would also meet his Saudi counterpart Prince Nayef "to reactivate the security agreement between the two countries".

Nayef was in Yemen early this month in a further attempt to resolve the 61-year border dispute which has led to several minor armed clashes between the Arab world's richest oil power and one of its most impoverished countries.
Yemen and Saudi Arabia signed a memorandum of understanding in 1995 in an attempt to end the border row. Since then they have exchanged high-level visits and held joint meetings to resolve the issue.
